requirements.summary: Accept one public input named query, use Amazon.fr to search for that article, process at most the first 10 products, visit each product page, extract product name, description, and price without inventing missing data, save the results to an Excel workbook at workflows/schema-portability-20261002/canonical20261007b-amazon-1/products.xlsx, and close the browser even on failure.

outcomes.description: Amazon.fr is searched using the provided query input.
Up to the first 10 product results are identified in order from the search results.
For each selected product page, the product name, description, and price are extracted when present; absent price/data and CAPTCHA or blocking are recorded explicitly.
An XLSX workbook is saved to workflows/schema-portability-20261002/canonical20261007b-amazon-1/products.xlsx.
The browser is closed even if navigation, extraction, CAPTCHA, or file creation fails.

tasks.objective: Open Amazon.fr home page without inventing a search URL, so the search box and any consent/blocker controls can be observed before interaction.
Proceed only if the Amazon.fr home observation is complete and not capture- or manifest-truncated; otherwise produce an explicit blocker state without pretending completeness.

Independently compact every complete bounded Amazon.fr home-page observation page into relevant observed facts only: search fields, consent controls, blocker/CAPTCHA indicators, exact observed references, supported actions, and needed DOM grouping/text. Empty arrays mean absence was checked on that source page.

Use only compact home-page facts to decide whether a fill-compatible Amazon search field is available, whether authorized cookie consent must be activated, or whether a CAPTCHA/blocker prevents progress.
Report that the initial Amazon.fr observation was incomplete or truncated; do not fabricate search controls or product rows.

value.text: Amazon.fr home observation was incomplete or truncated; search was not attempted.
Initial observation did not establish complete bounded page coverage.

tasks.objective: If a real observed cookie consent activation control is present, activate it, then re-observe and re-compact before any later reference use; otherwise expose the original compact state with matching ports.
Activate the observed cookie consent control using its current opaque reference and requestedAction=activate; do not click cookie-information links.
Freshly observe Amazon.fr after cookie consent because all pre-interaction references are expired.
Proceed after cookie consent only if the fresh observation is complete and not capture- or manifest-truncated.
Independently compact every complete bounded post-cookie observation page into relevant search/control/blocker facts and exact fresh references only.
Use only compact post-cookie facts to decide whether a fresh fill-compatible search box is available or a CAPTCHA/blocker remains.
Report that the post-cookie Amazon.fr observation was incomplete or truncated; do not reuse expired references.

value.text: Post-cookie Amazon.fr observation was incomplete or truncated; search was not attempted.
Fresh observation after cookie activation did not establish complete bounded page coverage.

tasks.objective: Expose the original home-state decision through ports that exactly match the cookie-accepted branch.

Only when a fresh fill-compatible search box is available, submit the public query and acquire complete search results; otherwise return an explicit blocked/no-search status with matching consumer-facing ports.
Search Amazon.fr by filling the observed current search field with the query and submitting it; no invented URL or selector is used.
Freshly observe the search results after submission; prior page references are no longer reused.
Process search results only when the results observation is complete and not capture- or manifest-truncated; otherwise return an explicit incomplete capture status with no fabricated products.

Independently compact each complete bounded search-results observation page into ordered-by-source candidate product facts, exact observed product link references/hrefs, visible list names/prices, and blocker facts; do not make the global first-ten decision here.

From compact search-result facts only, decide whether results are blocked and select at most the first 10 real product links in observed order, preserving exact source list values and noting any blocker explicitly.
Report incomplete search-result acquisition without inventing candidate products.

value.text: Search-result observation was incomplete or truncated; product selection was not attempted.
Search-result observation did not establish complete bounded page coverage.

tasks.objective: Expose a matching no-search status without fabricating product rows when Amazon.fr cannot be searched because a blocker/CAPTCHA, incomplete observation, or absent fill-compatible search box was observed.

value.text: Amazon.fr search was not submitted because no usable observed search field was available, capture was incomplete, or a blocker was detected.

tasks.objective: Sequentially visit each selected product in search-result order, at most the first 10 already selected items, and produce exactly one extraction result per selected item without parallelism.
For the current selected result, either open its observed href and extract details, or record an explicit skipped status if no navigable href was present.
Open the current product page using the observed resolved href for this result; this is a real per-product visit.
Only extract business details from complete bounded product-page observations; otherwise return an explicit incomplete-observation product status without inventing data.

Independently compact each complete bounded product-page observation page into product-detail facts: name candidates, description candidates, price candidates, CAPTCHA/blocking indicators, and exact observed text.

Use only compact product-page facts plus the current list item to produce one product row with nullable name, description, and price; absent fields, CAPTCHA, or blocking remain explicit in status and are never invented.
Return a product row for this visited result noting that product-page acquisition was incomplete, without claiming extracted name/description/price.

value.text: product page observation incomplete or truncated; details not fully extracted

tasks.objective: Return a single explicit status for the selected result when no navigable product href was available; no data is invented.

value.text: skipped: selected search result had no observed navigable product href

tasks.objective: Expose visited products only for an unblocked search; otherwise expose an empty visited-products array with the same port shape.
Expose the foreach product results as an array.
Expose no visited products when search was blocked or not submitted.

Assemble visited product rows in original order only. If search was blocked or produced no products, keep products empty and preserve explicit limitation text for workbook status without fabricating fallback product rows.

Create tab-separated spreadsheet content for XLSX generation at the required path, with columns name, description, price, status; normalize tabs and line breaks inside values, and include explicit status text if no product rows exist due to blocker/absence.

Write the XLSX workbook to workflows/schema-portability-20261002/canonical20261007b-amazon-1/products.xlsx using the generated TSV content and publish the returned filePath only after document_write succeeds.

always.objective: Close the browser page and context unconditionally, even if navigation, extraction, CAPTCHA/blocking, or file creation fails.
